Zombies aren't the real monsters. The people and society are. Zombies almost always get created because of government, and corporate greed. Zombies are a representation of the power struggles in society, and rampant capitalism, where problems are created by big organizations, but then the solutions, consequences are left to the common, ordinary people. At the heart of zombie stories is classism, and structures of control. The upper crust of society survives, while all those below battle it out with zombies, and each other. And you survive on your wits, and live on what you bring to the table.

The Zombie thing has been 'taking off' since the 70s and Dawn of the Dead which was also the first use of the 'people as the real monsters' trope.
